title: Hina Khan and Rajan Shahi Pose Together at Diwali Party After Years Apart
excerpt: A photograph shared by Shahi's daughter Ishika shows the actor with the Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai producer nearly a decade after her contested exit from the show.
body:
• Actor Hina Khan and producer Rajan Shahi were photographed together at a Diwali party, nearly a decade after her exit from Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai, IANS reported on November 11.
  • The photograph was shared on social media by Shahi's daughter Ishika and shows Khan posing with Shahi and another guest.
  • Khan played Akshara Maheshwari Singhania on the Hindi serial from 2009 to 2016; both she and Shahi spoke about their falling-out in 2024 interviews.
  • Neither Khan nor Shahi has commented on the photograph or said whether their professional relationship has changed.

One Diwali party photograph has done what nearly a decade of distance did not: put Hina Khan and Rajan Shahi in the same frame. The actor and the producer of Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai, who were reportedly not on talking terms for years after her exit from the show, posed together at a Diwali celebration, IANS reported from Mumbai on November 11. The picture was shared by Shahi's daughter Ishika on her social media account and shows Khan alongside Shahi and another woman.

The show that made her

Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai, the long-running Hindi television serial, was Khan's acting debut. She played its lead character, Akshara Maheshwari Singhania, from 2009 to 2016 — eight years in which she became one of the most recognisable faces on Indian television. Her departure in 2016 was followed by persistent reports of differences with Shahi.

What the 2024 interviews said

The falling-out moved from rumour to record in 2024, when both sides spoke about it. Khan acknowledged that her departure did not end on a positive note, while adding that she continued to respect the makers. Shahi, speaking at length, said friction had developed during the final phase of her tenure. He claimed disagreements arose over scripting — specifically over lines written in support of Shivangi Joshi's character Naira — and that Khan's contract was subsequently terminated. He also recalled that his decision to replace Khan as the show's lead prompted warnings from the channel that the show itself might be shut down.

What the photograph does and does not mean

The picture is candid and unannounced, and neither party arranged a formal reconciliation around it. According to India Forums' account of the moment, neither Khan nor Shahi has publicly spoken about the reunion or indicated that their professional equation has changed, and no new collaboration has been announced. For viewers who followed the original Akshara years, the significance is narrower and simpler: two people whose working relationship ended badly were willing to be photographed together at a festival gathering, ten years on. Whether it becomes anything more is, for now, a question only they can answer.
